summary.text: Rebecca Burkes is serving her second term in the Arkansas House of Representatives, representing District 11, which includes a portion of Springdale and the south central section of Benton County.

paragraphs.text: She earned a B.A. from the University of Texas, an M.S.O.M. from the University of Arkansas and a J.D. from Baylor University.
She worked as Deputy Director and General Counsel for the Arkansas Department of Heritage and on the faculty of the University of Wisconsin Law School, and lives in Springdale.
